provenance: 15 Town Hall cards from user-supplied character ability image; game reference: Salem 1692 2nd Edition rulebook. Not original game artwork.
notice: Names and ability summaries are reference data for an internal research prototype; obtain appropriate rights or use original game content for a public release.

characters.name: Cotton Mather
characters.ability_text: Evidence cards played against you are worth only one accusation

characters.name: William Phips
characters.ability_text: Once during the game, you may "confess" without revealing one of your own Tryal cards

characters.name: George Burroughs
characters.ability_text: Eight total accusations must be played against you to lose a Tryal

characters.name: Will Griggs
characters.ability_text: You may choose to use Alibi cards as if they were Witness cards, worth seven total accusations

characters.name: Martha Corey
characters.ability_text: You have the same ability as the first living player to your right
notes: Copied ability changes when the first living player to the right changes.
Usage-limit tracking for borrowed abilities needs an explicit digital ruling.

characters.name: Abigail Williams
characters.ability_text: When you play the final accusation on a Tryal, you may discard all accusations in front of your own Tryals

characters.name: Giles Corey
characters.ability_text: If you draw two Accusation cards on your turn (not Evidence or Witness), show the other players and draw a third card
notes: Only cards specifically named Accusation count toward the condition.

characters.name: Mary Warren
characters.ability_text: You are immune to the ill effects of the Matchmaker and Black Cat
notes: The exact handling of a Black Cat token assigned to Mary should be specified before coding.

characters.name: Sarah Good
characters.ability_text: Robbery and Arson cards played against you have no effect and are discarded

characters.name: Rebecca Nurse
characters.ability_text: Each time a Tryal is revealed on any other player, you may draw one card; Do not draw when Tryals are revealed by death or confession
notes: Do not trigger for Tryals revealed as a consequence of death or Confession.

characters.name: Tituba
characters.ability_text: Once during the game, on your turn, before drawing cards you may rearrange the cards in the deck for two lengths of the hourglass

characters.name: Thomas Danforth
characters.ability_text: If you place the sixth accusation on a player (or the seventh), you may reveal one of their Tryal cards

characters.name: Ann Putnam
characters.ability_text: If you place the final Accusation card on a Tryal, you may draw two cards before revealing the Tryal; you may use the new cards during the same turn
notes: Requires playing the specifically named Accusation card; not any accusation-producing card.

characters.name: John Proctor
characters.ability_text: Whenever a player dies, you take all blue cards in front of that player, and all cards in his or her hand, and place them in your own hand

characters.name: Samuel Parris
characters.ability_text: Twice during the game you may draw up to two cards from the discard pile instead of the deck; This counts as your turn, and you may not draw Black cards
notes: Consumes the turn; Black cards cannot be selected.
